data.description: Elegant Living | Prime Location | Flexible Payment Plan
data.display_address: Canal Crown 1, Canal Crown, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Canal Crown by Damac Properties is a prestigious 38-story development, crafted in collaboration with the renowned jewelry brand De Grisogono. This striking tower features luxury studios and 1-4 bedroom apartments, with the podium level housing an exclusive two-bedroom townhouse. The 36th and 37th floors are dedicated to opulent 3-4 bedroom duplexes, all offering panoramic views of Dubai Canal and Burj Khalifa through expansive windows.

The building's architecture stands out with its distinctive design. The facades are adorned with high-quality materials in light hues, while a radiant crown crowns the roof, reflecting sunlight. Interiors are lavishly finished with green and gray marble and gold accents, embodying a realm of luxury.

Residents of Canal Crown can enjoy premium amenities, including a garden of planets, relaxation pods, aqua-sports and virtual reality swimming pools, a space-themed spa, and a rooftop observation deck. The podium level features upscale stores, dining options, and a stylish lobby for social gatherings.

Conveniently located near Al Khail Road, Canal Crown offers easy access to key destinations: Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are just 10 minutes away, Dubai Marina and Marina Mall are 20 minutes away, and Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away.

Finance options are available through Premier Property Finance. For a free consultation, call +971 4323 3609.
